title: Concerning the Vessels.
text:
⟨p.111⟩
(ornament)
Concerning the Mighty Ones
Once {21}again, the disciples questioned him, saying to him: 'At this {22}moment
when the Father of Life poured forth these three Mighty Ones forth
from above — the one of the Mother, the one of the Darkness, and the one of the Fire — did he
eat upon a single way upon the side of the firmament, or rather did he
eat upon the first earth? Then he banished them out from the earth
{23}he cast them to a {24}place.'
{25}Then the apostle said to them: 'This which you have asked
{26}concerning the Mighty Ones{27} — thus is that which you shall come to know: when the Father
{28}of Life was about to pour {29}forth these three Mighty Ones, he
{30}ate the three upon this earth, each one to his place and
his appointed time. He ate; he hurled them down to the earth.
{31}Then he drew them out, he cast them out from this earth in the three
{32}garments — that of the Wind, that of the Mother, with that of the Fire — those mounted upon
{33}his body. He poured them out, he cast them down upon the three roads
{34}which he {35}established forth in the founding{36} of the cosmos
{37} {38} {39} not anyone remained
⟨p.112⟩
they have been set upon the faces of the earth out of the three {1}strongho{2}
lds, those there, so that you may discern their likeness and their type, when they are mani-
fest forth out of the cosmos. The el{3}{4}ent which has been prepared in the water is
the burning, with the salt of the sea, the salty (one), which is within, which surrounds
to the cosmos. But the preparation, on its part, which he has prepared as the Darkness
is, is this mountain of darkness which exists in the {5} of the side-of-radiance
unto the end. The time when the sun shines in the cosmos, no
lamp of light becomes manifest forth from it because of the darkness which gushes
{6}, covering the heaven from him. {7}, on its own part,
which has been left set in the fire upon the earth — these are the mountains, all
of them, with the springs, in which the channels of the fire gush up forth from
them, {8} they manifest forth there. For these are the preparation of the great strong-
hold — this then which has been mingled with the fire that comes upward
out of the earth into the mountains and the slopes {9}
the places where no tr{10}ee grows in them {11}
abound exceedingly, that very place, through the limb and {12}
{13} where no tree
grows in that very place.
Once again his disciples said to him: We beseech you, our Lord,
that you may {14} and make known to us out concerning the strongholds that
surround the cosmos: for what reason were they not sent forth from the heaven to
the fossae upon which they were established? But rather they were sent forth first
to the earth, then they raised them up out of the earth, and they cast them up-
ward to the height.
Then the Illuminator said to his disci-
ples: Be it known to you in this manner that this is — the Father of
Life sent forth the strongholds from the heaven to the earth — he sent them forth
for this matter, in order that the water also and the darkness and the fire which
exist in the three earths might draw and {15}come up against those
that came down from above the earths {16} purification, and they {17}
purify (them). For this reason he sent forth the strongholds downward to the eart{18}
those of the water, those of the darkness, and those of the fire — in order that
the water, the darkness and the fire that exist in the earths might draw upward {19}
against those that came down from above. First indeed, befor{20}
everything, {21}he sent forth the water of Error, {22}their midst, of the archo{23}
that are above. He puri{24}fied the firmaments out of the {25}{26}
{27} the waters {28} of darkness; he sent them forth down{29}
⟨p.113⟩
Waters fell from heaven to earth; thus also are these waters,
themselves, which are below in the earth: they too were drawn; they came
upward from below to meet the waters that had come forth from heaven to the lands.
{0} purified the waters from the Darkness which is in them.
Then they drove them forth to the outside, casting them into a great place
of deceit, and a shore of the sea — this which surrounds the cosmos,
this in which the ships sail. After the water, was poured out
the Darkness; they purified the firmaments, rolling forth from
there the Darkness gathered upon him; they cast (it) down to the earth.
As they purified the firmaments, so also is this (the manner) in which they purified
the lands. The Darkness which is in the lands was drawn upward to meet the Darkness which had been
{1} forth from heaven; they drove them forth from both, gathering {2}
{3} {4} that yonder of the Darkness {5}
{6} the water. And the fire was poured out from heaven to the earth.
{7} hour. At that very moment also, the fire that was gathered within
[in] the lower earth was drawn, came up to meet its kindred.
Fire was added upon fire. Afterwards they drove it forth, casting it
into the West which is outside — that which had been [established for] them outside the
cosmos. According to the manner in which they purified the firmaments which are above to be a place
of going for the Illuminators {8}
{9} thus also is this the (manner) in which they purified the lands of the lower part, driving
forth from them the fire and the Darkness and the water {10}
they purified them, that the three powers might come up — that of the wind, the water,
and the fire — those which come up through the midst, forth from the Omophoros that
bears the lands.
